name: Night Light warm Light
description:
Rechargeable Cordless Table Lamp, Adjustable Height, Warm Light Touch Control (ZL-329B)

This cordless table lamp gives a warm, soft light, and you can set the height to fit the space. The battery is built in, so you can use it anywhere without looking for an outlet.

Key features

Adjustable height: The telescopic stainless steel pole pulls out or pushes in. Keep it short as a bedside night light, or extend it into a taller table lamp for a desk, dining table or living room.
Soft warm light: The light is steady, with no flicker, which suits reading, meals or sleep.
Touch control: Tap the base to switch the lamp on or off. There are no switches or cords.
Rechargeable and cordless: Move it from room to room, or take it outside to a patio, balcony, café table or camping trip.
Twisted shade: The white shade has a twisted, faceted design. It spreads the light evenly and looks good whether the lamp is on or off.
Stable base: The black base is round and weighted so the lamp stays upright at any height.
